描述_ZN: The Dove on the Axis, modern, painted by Chen Shizeng, on paper with color, 122.8 cm in length and 32.5 cm in width.　　Self-titled: "Recorded by Chen Hengke in the ninth month of the autumn of Geng Shen in the Hall of Sophies." Inscription: "Shi-Zeng" seal.　　The year "Geng Shen" is the ninth year of the Republic of China (1920).　　The picture shows two turtledoves standing on top of a boulder, with bamboo branches and petunias beside them.　　The stone is not painted with much ink, and the brushwork is haphazard, simply showing the concave and convex texture of the stone surface; the flowers and leaves are flexible and flying, with a mixture of color and ink; the birds are not Shi-Zeng's specialty, and the two birds in the picture are simple in form, with a more restrained brushwork.　　The "turtledove" in the painting harmonizes with "nine", which on the one hand implies that the painting was made in September, and on the other hand, the Chinese traditionally regard "nine" as an auspicious number, which has a meaning of good luck.
